description:
Since ancient times, fairies have existed to maintain balance in the world, each governing a fundamental human desire - wealth, pleasure, appetite, rest, and honor. Pence, a money fairy with an insatiable thirst for riches, was poised to become the next ruler of the fairy realm. But his greed came at a cost. When he exploits his powers at the expense of others, he is cast out and stripped of his status, forced to live among humans. Now stranded in the mortal world, Pence crosses paths with Yoo-Jin, a relentless workaholic struggling to make ends meet. But old habits die hard, and Pence's schemes for easy wealth quickly backfire. As karma catches up to him, he’s about to learn the true cost of greed—and what it really means to earn one’s fortune.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes prologue.*
